description: This header defines classes and interfaces for managing F1-U gateway bearers in a CU-UP context, including notifier interfaces, bearer creation, and UDP gateway specifics.

classes.name: f1u_cu_up_gateway_bearer_rx_notifier
classes.description: Interface for a notifier that handles new PDU events for the RX bearer.

classes.name: f1u_cu_up_gateway_bearer
classes.description: Interface for an F1-U gateway bearer, including stop and get_bind_address methods.

classes.name: f1u_cu_up_gateway
classes.description: Main interface for managing F1-U CU-UP gateways, including bearer creation and TEID attachment.

classes.name: f1u_cu_up_udp_gateway
classes.description: UDP-specific implementation of the CU-UP gateway interface.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Handles the event of a new PDU received.

methods.name: get_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the bind address of the gateway.

methods.name: create_cu_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new CU bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: get_bind_port
methods.description: Returns the bind port for UDP gateway.
